method.label: model-implied GBM probability from robust expiry-level IV surface
method.close: terminal probability beyond target at expiry
method.touch: first-passage probability of touching target before expiry
method.iv: one robust near-ATM reference IV per expiry; Yahoo sentinel-like IV values are down-weighted/filtered
method.monotonic: probabilities are constrained to a coherent monotone CDF on each side of spot
method.note: OI/volume/VEX/GEX are context drivers; they do not arbitrarily add percentage points to probability.
